name: Lye Batenkaitos
japaneseName: ライ・バテンカイトス
description: Lye Batenkaitos (also romanized as Ley Batenkaitos) was the Sin Archbishop of the Witch Cult representing the Gourmet aspect of Gluttony. Alongside his siblings Roy Alphard and Rui Arneb, he devoured the names and memories of countless victims—most notably Rem and Crusch Karsten—serving as a terrifying primary antagonist across Arc 3, Arc 5, and Arc 6.
